

# calculate residuals from the fitted model

```{r}
data_fitted_r$ind |>
  filter(taxon_name %in% top8_taxa) |>
  ggplot(aes(residual)) +
  geom_histogram() + 
  facet_wrap(~taxon_name)
```

# Compare medoid climate centres to above


```{r}
data_climate_centres_med <- arrow::read_parquet("data-processed/climate_centres.parquet")

data_climate_centres <-
  data_traits_climate |>
  select(taxon_name, log_annual_precipitation_mn, average_temperature_mn) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(annual_precipitation_mn = exp(log_annual_precipitation_mn)) |>
  left_join(
    by = "taxon_name",
    data_climate_centres_med |> select(taxon_name, average_temperature_med = average_temperature, annual_precipitation_med = annual_precipitation)
  )

p <- data_climate_centres |>
  ggplot(aes(annual_precipitation_mn, annual_precipitation_med)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, col= "red") +
  theme_classic() 
 
p
```




# Generate panel of species plots

```{r}

state

plot_distn <-
  ggplot() +
  labs(x = "latitude", y = "longitude") +
  theme_classic()

plot_fits_r <-
  ggplot() +
  labs(title = "Response to rainfall",
    x = "annual precipitation (mm)", y = "height (m)") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic()

plot_fits_t <-
  ggplot() +
  labs(title = "Response to temperature",
    x = "temperature (°C)", y = "height (m)") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic()

plot_repsonse_2d <-
  ggplot() +
  labs( title = "Response to rainfall and temperature",
    x = "temperature (°C)", y = "annual precipitation (mm)") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic()

p_all <- plot_distn + plot_repsonse_2d + plot_fits_r + plot_fits_t + plot_layout(ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(title = "Species name")

p_all
```
